data.name: Rayaal
data.gender_notes: Rayaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Raiyan' meaning 'a little one', 'a young goat' or 'a ray of light'. This name is rich in symbolism and evokes feelings of joy, lightness and happiness. It is a perfect choice for parents who want to instill a sense of playfulness and positivity in their child's life. The name Rayaal carries the meaning “Little Ray” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rayaal usually hope their child will grow to embody little ray and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the light of God within, and the joy of being a part of His creation.
data.etymology: Rayaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Ray.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayaal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ريال
in_arabic.meaning: ريال اسم يعني الشخص الذي يرتفع علوا ورفعة في الشرف
in_arabic.long_meaning: ريال هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يرتفع علوا ورفعة في الشرف، وينسب إلى ريا وهو مفهوم الارتفاع والعلو في اللغة العربية. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، مما يعطيه أهمية دينية كبيرة. يستخدم الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على المكانة الرفيعة والشرف العظيم.

in_urdu.name: ریال
in_urdu.meaning: ریال نام کا مطلب ہے بلند و بالا، شرف و منزلت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریال ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بلند و بالا، شرف و منزلت۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے بنا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کی گہری اہمیت ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں بھی اس جیسے الفاظ کی جڑیں ملتی ہیں، جو اس نام کو روحانی اور دینی اہمیت دیتی ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام روایتی اور مقبول ہے.

in_hindi.name: रियाल
in_hindi.meaning: रियाल नाम का अर्थ है उच्च और सम्मानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: रियाल एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है उच्च और सम्मानित। यह नाम अरबी मूल से बना है और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और महत्वपूर्ण नाम के रूप में किया जाता है। इस नाम की जड़ें इस्लामी संस्कृति और अरबी भाषा में हैं।

in_pashto.name: ریال
in_pashto.meaning: ریال د لوړوالي او درناوي نوم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ریال یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د لوړوالي او درناوي معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کی دا نوم د پښتنو دودیزو نومونو څخه دی چی د عربي او اسلامی ثقافت څخه ګټنه اخیستل شوې ده.

in_english.name: Rayaal
in_english.long_meaning: Rayaal is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots, signifying 'exalted, elevated, noble'. Etymologically linked to concepts of rising and high status, the name holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, similar terms implying elevation and nobility are found. The name Rayaal symbolizes aspirations for high moral and social standing, reflecting a desire for honor and respect.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rayaal holds significant cultural influence in various Muslim communities around the world. It is a beautiful and unique name that carries the essence of youth, joy, and playfulness. In some cultures, the name Rayaal is associated with the tradition of animal sacrifice during the Islamic holy month of Eid al-Adha. The young goat, symbolizing the sacrifice and obedience to Allah, is given the name Rayaal as a sign of respect and appreciation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rayaal holds deep significance as it is derived from the Arabic word 'Raiyan', which means 'a ray of light'. This alludes to the idea that the child bearing this name is a light in the world, illuminating the lives of those around them. The name also signifies the divine guidance and protection of Allah, who is the ultimate guide and source of light in our lives. Parents who choose this name for their child are instilling a strong sense of purpose, faith, and spirituality in their child's life.
